caption: 💌 Do not forget to save for snack ideas & follow me  @bella.healthytinytummies for more healthy toddler-friendly recipes 💛 ✨ Healthy Banana Oat Cake for Toddlers ✨ 🚫Sugar-free, 🚫flour-free,🌿 soft & naturally sweet. ✅ Perfect for tiny hands. 💛Ingredients: 1 ripe banana🍌 120g rolled oats 1 cup milk (250ml) 1 egg 🥚 1 tsp baking powder 1/2 tsp cinnamon For the topping: 1 Banana 🍌  60g mixed berries 🍓 Steps: 1️⃣ In a blender: 1 banana, oats, milk, egg, baking powder, cinnamon → blend until smooth. 2️⃣ Pour into a small cake pan "25×15cm" 3️⃣ Top with banana slices + berries. 4️⃣ Bake at 180°C for 20–25 min. 💡 Why it works: ✔ Naturally sweetened with banana ✔ Whole grains for energy ✔ Soft texture safe for toddlers #toddlersnacks #healthybabyfood #nosugaradded #glutenfreesnacks
